title: Ex-Camarines Norte Gov. Casimiro 'Roy' Padilla Jr. dies at 77
summary: Former Camarines Norte Gov. Casimiro "Roy" Aquino Padilla Jr. died at the age of 77 on Tuesday, his family confirmed Wednesday.
